gaps: The prompt anchors are not established by these old E14 logs. Exact submitted-PDF table and protocol matching remains pending in the separate manuscript audit.
3B default PPL cache has Hadamard seeds 0/1 and PrismQuant k8/kmax seed0 only; it cannot establish a three-seed mean.
8B default PPL cache has all three seeds, but both 3B and 8B task-accuracy caches have seed0 only.
Historical zero-shot ran log_samples=False; paired item bootstrap cannot be reconstructed from task aggregates. New evaluations must preserve item IDs, metric values, and sample hashes.
Completed E14 checkpoints were archived to Hugging Face and deleted from the original artifact root. Several Hub cache directories contain DONE manifests but no layer files.
8B public pinned revision has no g128_asym weight variants. Do not confuse activation g128 with weight g128_asym.
Historical JSON logs lack some new requested provenance fields such as exact experiment command and code commit; auditing their file hashes now does not recreate missing historical provenance.
Large base/quantized weight content hashes have not been recomputed. File existence, sizes and available content-addressed blob names are recorded without claiming full cryptographic validation.
